name: attachment
title: Attachment Chip
description: A chat attachment: images as a thumbnail that sharpens from a blur once decoded, files as a typed chip. Upload progress is a ring that springs between reports; a failure shakes once and offers Retry; removing one lets its neighbours slide into the gap.
docs: Import AttachmentChip and AttachmentList from components/eased/attachment/attachment-chip. Pair with useAttachments from components/eased/_primitives/chat-core/chat-core.
